request_receipts_or_travel_documents.Phase 6: Send Documents: Generate and send the requested documents via the chosen channel

message_list.content: Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?
message_list.guideline_text: Start the conversation with a warm greeting and introduction. Use: 'Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?'

message_list.content: Hi, I'm calling to request my flight receipt and itinerary to be sent to my email. Could you help me with that?
Got it. Document types selected: receipt and itinerary confirmation.
message_list.guideline_text: Select Document Types: Ask which booking artifacts to send such as receipt, invoice, e-ticket, ticket numbers, or itinerary confirmation and capture the selection in one reply

message_list.content: Sure, my email is aarav.allen@protonmail.com. Would you also be able to provide any details on what to do if there is an issue with my passport or immigration when I'm traveling?

Thanks, I can send your receipt and itinerary to aarav.allen@protonmail.com. Please provide:
- Booking reference
- Full name exactly as on the ticket

General guidance for passport or immigration issues:
- Before you travel: confirm your passport validity, any required visas, and that your name matches your ticket. Carry originals of required documents plus copies.
- At the airport or border: arrive early, keep documents handy, and speak with the airline desk or a supervisor if a question comes up. Follow the instructions given by border officers. If you need help with entry requirements, contact the relevant embassy or consulate.
- Keep proof of your travel plans such as return or onward tickets, accommodation details, and trip funds, as these are often requested.
message_list.guideline_text: If the caller reports denied boarding due to documentation, immigration refusal, border authority disputes, or requests liability/exception determinations (excluding general documentation requirement questions), transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: Sure, my booking reference is 8OSES5 and my full name is Aarav Allen. I actually had a previous incident where there was a delay and my baggage was lost. It had some high-value items in it. How should I proceed if something like that happens again?

Thanks, Aarav. I will send your receipt and itinerary for booking 8OSES5 to aarav.allen@protonmail.com.

If your bag is delayed or missing again
- Go to the baggage service desk in the arrivals hall before leaving and file a report. Provide your bag tag number and boarding pass, and get a written reference number.
- Give a clear description of the bag and contents, plus your delivery address and contact details. Photos help if you have them.
- Keep the report copy and all documents related to your trip and bag tags.
- For essential items you must buy during the delay, keep the receipts and attach them to your file when you follow up.
- If the bag contains critical medication or important documents, tell the agent immediately so it can be prioritized.
- Use the reference number on your report for all follow-ups using the contact details provided on the report.
- For future trips, keep high-value or irreplaceable items in your carry-on.
message_list.guideline_text: If the caller reports lost/delayed baggage containing high-value items, medicine, passports, or irreplaceable items and requests exception/compensation determination, transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: Thanks for the advice. Also, I was curious about what would happen if I'm denied boarding because of a passport issue. What should I do in that situation?
I understand. I will connect you to a human agent who can assist with denied boarding or passport documentation issues. Please hold while I transfer you now.
message_list.guideline_text: If the caller reports denied boarding due to documentation, immigration refusal, border authority disputes, or requests liability/exception determinations (excluding general documentation requirement questions), transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: That would be great, thank you.
Thank you, Aarav. It’s been a pleasure assisting you today. We appreciate you choosing Celestar Air. Have a smooth journey and a wonderful day. Goodbye.
message_list.guideline_text: End the call politely, ensuring the caller feels valued and assisted.
